Introduction
This document outlines 
the equipment tests I1, which must performed on an annually bases as indicated 
by Y1 in the titled block The tests will be done 
after any fault, 
at capital repair, and at acceptance tests.
The first draft 
initiated at High Dam HPS, by eng. Hossain Mahrous and tested at 16 Jan 2002
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category, Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area, Wear 
safety helmet, shoes, 
 Presence the industrial safety 
supervisor.
Switch off the unit.
Separate the primary 
terminals of v.t (high winding).and the secondary terminals of v.t (low 
winding).
Switch on the grounds.

Safety helmet, safety belt, 
 rags, and silicagel
Megger:

M4000 (Insulation analyzer),
Micro ohmmeter type AC 10, 
 Ratio tester type ATRT-03
